videoTitle: Change the belt on your Kirby system
steps: 1. With the Power Nozzle off, rotate the belt lifter clockwise until the green arrows line up. Unlock the Rug Plate by unhooking the two latches on the rear of the Power Nozzle. Pull on the rear edge of the Rug Plate to remove.
2. Slide off the old belt and replace with a new one.

3. Make sure the numbers on the Brush Roll end caps are the same on both sides before inserting it into the Power Nozzle. Place the belt and Brush Roll back into the Power Nozzle. One of the Brush Roll ends is larger than the other. The Brush Roll will only fit in the Power Nozzle one way. Center the belt on the Brush Roll.
4. Place the Rug Plate on the front of the Bumper first and then pull it over the rear. Secure it in place with the two latches.
5. Turn the Belt Lifter counterclockwise until the red arrows line up. The belt should catch on the hook inside the nozzle. Reattach the Power Nozzle to the unit.
6. Turn the Belt Lifter clockwise until the green arrows line up.
7. Turn the unit on and check that the Brush Roll Indicator Light is on. This means that the brush roll is spinning.
1. First make sure your outer bag is unzipped and the top adaptor is pulled out.
2. Take a new disposable bag out of the packaging.

3. Rest the cardboard faceplate of the disposable filter bag against the bottom of the adaptor. Pivot the faceplate against the flat surface of the adaptor and bend and press the tab at the top of the faceplate until it’s secure. The bag support strap should be connected through the small hole on the adaptor, which is over the stud.
4. Once connected, place the whole bag inside the outer bag and close the zipper.

videoTitle: How to uninstall the Power Nozzle
steps: 1. First, you’ll want to pull the belt lifter handle on the Power Nozzle, or the head of the vacuum, toward you and turn it counterclockwise until the red arrows line up. The hook should catch and stretch the belt inside the nozzle.
2. Raise the headlight hood.
3. Reset the two hooks on the back of the nozzle on the attaching bar, which is located on the front of the unit.
4. Press the nozzle against the unit and secure with the Accessory Lock.
5. Pull the belt lifter handle toward you again and turn it clockwise until the green arrows line up. (See page 22 of the owner manual).

videoTitle: How to adjust the Power Nozzle height
steps: 1. To adjust the height of your vacuum, use the toe-touch control that is located over the front wheel. The numbered settings are for carpet and floors.
2. The dotted settings are for accessories and other cleaning needs.
3. Turn the unit on and press the toe-touch upper control pedal as often as necessary to lower the Power Nozzle to its lowest setting.
4. Press the toe-touch lower control pedal one notch at a time to raise it to your preferred height. Listen for each click as it raises or lowers.
* One-click is for deep pile carpeting.
* Two clicks are for long fiber carpeting.
* Three clicks are for pet hair removal.
* Four clicks and up are for hose and attachments
1. Make sure your unit is turned off and is unplugged, and the Power Nozzle is removed (see page 22 of the owner manual).

3. Place the hooks of the attachment hose over the attaching bar.

1. First, remove the Power Nozzle, then remove the outer bag.
2. Lift and remove the waste tray from the MSSS and set aside for now.
3. The carpet brush roll must be used when shampooing carpet.
4. Insert the baffle strip if necessary with the flat side facing the brush roll.
5. Press the toe-touch control bottom pedal all of the way down to raise the front of the unit.

videoTitle: Install the Hard Floor Brush Roll
steps: 1. When you are converting your machine to clean hard surface floors, you first need to remove the power nozzle, or head of the machine, and the outer bag.
2. Then, remove the Waste Tray from the MSSS.
3. To remove the carpet brush roll and insert the Rotary Mop, turn the MSSS nozzle belt handle clockwise until the green arrows line up.
4. Turn the nozzle upside down and pull on the belt until it’s lose and remove the carpet brush roll.
5. Take the belt off the carpet brush roll and place onto the Rotary Mop.
6. Once the belt is on the appropriate brush roll, insert it back into the MSSS.
7. Push up on the belt with your finger and turn the belt lifter handle counterclockwise until the red arrows line up.
8. Raise the unit by pressing all the way down on the toe-touch pedal. Then, connect the hooks on the back of the MSSS to the attaching bar.
9. Push the MSSS up against the unit, turn the Accessory Lock clockwise, and turn the belt lifter clockwise until the green arrows line up.
10. Lower the hood and put on the waste tray.

5. Take the belt off the carpet brush roll and place onto the Miracle Shine brush roll.

9. Push the MSSS up against the unit, turn the Accessory Lock clockwise, and turn the belt lifter clockwise until the green arrows line up.

1. First, remove the power nozzle, or front head of the vacuum (see page 22 of the owner manual).
2. Place the hooks on the back of the air guard over the attaching bar located on the front of the unit.
3. Push the air guard against the unit and turn the accessory lock clockwise to secure it in place.
4. Remove the outer bag by pressing the bag release button on the top of the bag and rotating the bottom base of the bag away from the unit to remove.
5. Connect the hose to the air exhaust port. Simply line up the arrow on the end of the hose with the arrow on the port; twist the hose clockwise until it locks.

videoTitle: Install the Tile & Grout Brush Roll
steps: 1. When you are converting your machine to clean tile & grout, you first need to remove the power nozzle, or head of the machine, and the outer bag (see page 22 of the owner manual).
2. Remove the Waste Tray from the MSSS.
3. Insert the Tile & Grout Brush Roll.
4. Once the belt is on the appropriate brush roll, insert it back into the MSSS.
5. Push up on the belt with your finger and turn the belt lifter handle counterclockwise until the red arrows line up.
6. Raise the unit by pressing all the way down on the toe-touch pedal. Then, connect the hooks on the back of the MSSS to the attaching bar.
7. Push the MSSS up against the unit and turn the Accessory Lock clockwise, and turn the belt lifter clockwise until the green arrows line up.
8. Lower the hood and put on the waste tray.

videoTitle: How to install the portable sprayer
steps: 1. Once your unit is set up in the blower mode, it’s time to set up your sprayer.
2. Unscrew the jar and fill it ¾ full with non-flammable liquid. The dip tube needs to be attached to the sprayer before screwing in the jar.
3. Next, attach the sprayer to the end of the hose.
4. Hold sprayer horizontally and turn the unit on. Squeeze the trigger to spray the solution onto a newspaper to check that it works.
5. Turn the control on the trigger to adjust the spray pattern.

videoTitle: How to install the Turbo Accessory
steps: 1. First, assemble the turbo sander and unsnap the sander dust shroud and lift off.
2. Rotate the clamp levers up on the side of the turbo accessory, slide a sheet of sandpaper into the front clap and lock lever.
3. Tightly wrap the sandpaper around the bottom of the turbo accessory and tuck the end into the rear clamp and lock.
4. On a level surface, reattach the sander dust shroud with the opening to the back, and insert the hose.
5. Hold the turbo accessory at the top and bottom and turn your Kirby on.
6. Finally, turn the turbo accessory on.
